privacyPolicy_intro: Dungeon Quest Reborn Wiki ("we", "us") is a fan-made wiki. This policy explains what data we collect, how we use it, and the choices you have.
privacyPolicy_infoCollect_p1: We collect minimal personal information. The only data processed is what is needed to serve you the site and understand its usage.
privacyPolicy_infoCollect_auto: Automatically collected data: your IP address, browser type, pages visited and referral source, collected via analytics.
privacyPolicy_infoCollect_cookies: Cookies: we use cookies for theme preferences and analytics.
privacyPolicy_infoCollect_noPersonal: We do not collect your name, email address, or other contact details unless you contact us directly.
privacyPolicy_howUse_p1: We use the information we collect to operate and improve the wiki, understand which guides are popular, and fix technical issues.
privacyPolicy_howUse_analytics: Analytics: aggregated, anonymized usage statistics to see which content performs best.
privacyPolicy_howUse_performance: Performance: monitoring to detect and fix errors, outages and performance issues.
privacyPolicy_howUse_preferences: Preferences: remembering your theme (dark/light/system) and locale.
privacyPolicy_dataRights_p1: Depending on your location, you may have the right to access, correct, delete, or restrict the processing of your personal data.
privacyPolicy_dataRights_optOut: Opt out of analytics: use your browser's Do Not Track setting or a privacy extension.
privacyPolicy_dataRights_cookies: Control cookies: most browsers let you block or delete cookies.
privacyPolicy_dataRights_contact: Contact us at any time to exercise your rights.
privacyPolicy_thirdParty_p1: We use a small number of third-party services to run and measure the wiki.
privacyPolicy_thirdParty_ga: Google Analytics: measures site usage. Google's privacy policy governs its data handling.
privacyPolicy_thirdParty_steam: Roblox: links to the game's official Roblox page. Roblox's terms and privacy policy apply on their platform.
privacyPolicy_thirdParty_discord: Discord: community links to the official Dungeon Quest Reborn Discord server.
privacyPolicy_security_p1: We take reasonable measures to protect the wiki and its data. However, no method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure.
privacyPolicy_children_p1: The wiki does not knowingly collect personal information from children. If you believe a child has provided us personal data, contact us and we will remove it.
privacyPolicy_changes_p1: We may update this policy from time to time. We will post any changes on this page with an updated date.
privacyPolicy_contact_p1: If you have questions about this privacy policy, reach out through our community channels.

faq_classes_q: How do I choose a class?
faq_classes_a: Each class offers a unique playstyle. Warriors excel in melee combat, while Mages dominate with ranged spells. Choose based on whether you prefer up-close fighting or casting from a distance.
faq_leveling_q: What is the fastest way to level up?
faq_leveling_a: Focus on clearing dungeons that match your level range. Higher experience rewards come from defeating bosses and completing dungeon objectives efficiently.
faq_gold_q: How do I earn gold quickly?
faq_gold_a: Clear dungeons, defeat enemies, and sell unwanted equipment. Boss drops and rare items yield the highest gold returns when sold to vendors.
faq_dungeons_a: Dungeons are instanced areas filled with enemies and a final boss. Clear all rooms to reach the boss, then defeat it to claim legendary loot and progress to harder dungeons.
faq_bosses_a: Learn each boss attack patterns and elemental weaknesses. Use appropriate weapons and spells, maintain mobility, and coordinate with party members for the best results.
faq_gear_q: How do I get better equipment?
faq_gear_a: Defeat dungeon bosses for legendary drops, craft gear from collected materials, and optimize enchantments to maximize your combat power for higher difficulties.
faq_spells_a: Match spells to your class and build. Area-of-effect spells excel in crowded rooms, while single-target spells are best for boss encounters.
faq_multiplayer_a: Yes! Party up with friends to tackle dungeons together. Coordinated teams with complementary classes can clear content much faster than solo play.
spell_0_effect: Smashes the ground dealing area damage and knocking back enemies in a wide radius.
spell_1_effect: Summons a devastating ice storm that damages and slows all enemies in the target area over time.
spell_2_effect: Unleashes a wave of fire that travels forward, burning all enemies in its path.
spell_3_effect: Calls down a bolt of lightning on the target, dealing massive single-target damage.
spell_4_effect: Sends out a wave of healing energy that restores health to all party members in range.
spell_5_effect: Launches a small fireball that deals moderate damage and applies burn over time.
